sections.name: groupCaseEvidence
sections.title: Evidence grouping function
sections.what: Sorts each document into the core or supporting group based on its id, and returns both groups without changing any document.
sections.why: Stated in the code comment: presentation grouping only, so stored types, states and extraction stay as they are.
sections.watch_out: The rule relies on the id text, so changing how ids are named would move records between groups.

summary: Splits case documents into core records and supporting material for display, without changing any document.
purpose: Lets the case page show main records first and optional sample material separately.
why: The code comment says it is presentation only and never changes stored data. This is stated in the code.
how: Goes through each document in order. If the document id contains the fixture marker, it goes to the supporting list. Otherwise it goes to the core list. It returns both lists.
outputs: An object with two lists: core and supporting.
risks: Grouping depends on the text fixture appearing in the id. Any real record whose id contains that text would be shown as supporting material.
debug: If a record is in the wrong group, check its id for the fixture marker text.
